name: Burun Ruuk Village
title: Burun Ruuk Village
summary: The Burun Ruuk village in the Blackmire swamp, centred on the entrance bunker of the Temple of Ixir Zi (blood stains, fallen Burun, spears). Eight stone huts with bronze symbols and eight 19 m carved wooden totems ring it among swamp channels and giant trees.

landmarks.name: Temple of Ixir Zi entrance
landmarks.note: Bunker 0x0100110A with blood decals, spears and fallen Burun.

landmarks.name: Burun huts
landmarks.note: Eight 0x010031BD huts with bronze symbols in a ring 100-170 m out.
